pages.title: Explorer
pages.text: $(bold)The compass, and the waystones on the Monoliths: wake them and travel between those you have woken. Making, placing and breaking waystones wait for Attunement.$(br2)$(thing)Copper Age$(n), ring 2.$(br)$(thing)8 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Ranger.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Travel 5,000 blocks$(n)$(br2)Pays 2 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
